steps.text: Sunday's boiled eggs — take 100/150 g (250 g total, 5 of the 6 boiled) — peeled and halved.
Avocado (55/70 g) sliced, or roughly mashed straight onto the plate.
Chilli salt over both — 2 parts flaky salt to 1 part chilli flakes, briefly ground together.
Cucumber (60/70 g) in thick batons alongside.

why: Make the chilli salt in a jar, once. This is three ingredients and no cooking, so it lives or dies on seasoning — and reaching for a jar is the difference between doing that properly and not bothering.
notes: No D0-003 substitutions apply (no oil, no lettuce). batchTakeG covers the boiled-egg take: 250 g (5 eggs) of Sunday's 6-egg/300 g batch — the 6th egg (50 g) is the spare the Sunday op text itself earmarks as eaten straight away, explicit headroom rather than a defect (see prep-b.json).
